name: Stoat-Chat
description: A modern self-hosted chat platform, Discord-style.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (mongodb/), uploaded files (silo/), the message broker (rabbit/) and the secret keys (state/). Back up the whole folder: without state/secrets.env uploaded files can't be read.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Stoat web app, API, websocket and file server, published on host as 6167

ports.name: Port 6168
ports.description: Voice and video (LiveKit) over TCP, published on host as 6168. Must stay 6168.

ports.name: Port 6169
ports.description: Voice and video (LiveKit) over UDP, published on host as 6169. Must stay 6169.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Your main address for Stoat, like https://chat.example.com or http://192.168.1.20:6167. Stoat works from any address you open it at; this one is used for links in emails and, when it is an IP, for voice. Voice and video need HTTPS.
